## Changes Checklist
- [ ] **100% Commission-Free & Neutral**: No commercial broker ads, sponsored project badges, or affiliate referrals added.
- [ ] **DPDP Act 2023 Compliance**: Zero telemetry/user data harvesting without explicit consent.
- [ ] **Multi-Device Responsive**: Tested across smartphone (<768px), tablet (768px-1024px), and desktop.
- [ ] **Accurate Statutory Data**: Any legal citations (RERA sections, BUDS Act, PMAY-U 2.0 slabs, stamp duty rates) verified with government gazettes.
- [ ] **Build Check**: Ran `npm run build` locally with exit code 0.
- [ ] **SQLite Micro-API**: If modifying backend, tested `server.mjs` endpoint compatibility.
